image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a custom chrome alloy wheel mounted on a black vehicle. The wheel features a multi-spoke design with a polished finish and a central emblem. A black rubber tire with visible tread and sidewall lettering surrounds the rim. Reflections of the environment are visible on the shiny chrome surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheel exhibits a distinct outer lip where the tire seats and a recessed center area containing the spokes and hub.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A black rubber tire is clearly mounted on the circumference of the metal rim.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheel features an exposed spoke alloy design with a polished chrome finish.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Tread blocks are visible on the top arc of the tire, and faint white sidewall lettering is discernible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white lettering on the tire sidewall is slightly indistinct and lacks the sharp, crisp edges of real molded rubber text, appearing slightly 'painted on' or blurred.

The reflections on the chrome spokes are complex but slightly inconsistent in their warping, suggesting minor geometric inaccuracies in the reflection mapping, though not severe enough to break realism.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class conformance at a high level.
To check for seamless connectivity between the tire and rim, ensuring no floating pixels or bleeding edges common in AI generations.
To verify the physical depth and overlapping logic of the complex spoke design, ensuring no impossible intersections.
To analyze the fidelity of the chrome reflections and identify any subtle smearing or noise artifacts.

focus_areas: Logical consistency of chrome reflections on curved surfaces
Clarity and realism of tire sidewall text
Structural plausibility of the spoke geometry
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tire sidewall lettering; AI often struggles with rendering legible, physically molded text on tires. Also, scrutinize the reflections on the chrome spokes for any 'melting' or illogical distortions that don't match the surrounding environment.
